toolsPreview.name: convert_amount
toolsPreview.description: Convert baking ingredient amounts between units (cups, grams, tbsp, tsp, ounces, ml, pounds, kg) using accurate density data (King Arthur + USDA). E.g. 2 cups of all-purpose flour to grams. Free anonymous tier: 20 calls/day per IP. More calls need an API key (https://ko-fi.com/yugutou/shop) or use the free website https://bakingtab.com.

toolsPreview.name: convert_temperature
toolsPreview.description: Convert oven temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

toolsPreview.name: search_ingredients
toolsPreview.description: Search the baking ingredient database (100+ ingredients with density in g/ml). Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

toolsPreview.name: scale_recipe
toolsPreview.description: Scale a recipe to a target number of servings. Pass servings and ingredients array. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

toolsPreview.name: list_units
